summary: Tested Contract Attachments feature for ClauseGuard Agiloft Integration. All 6 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with correct tabs and placeholder states.

minor.issue: Returns 0 clauses for attachment 1085 (PWS document). This is expected behavior - the PWS (Performance Work Statement) document doesn't contain FAR/DFARS clause numbers in extractable format.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: POST /api/agiloft/contract-attachments - list attachments for a contract
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: Tested with contract_id=663. Returns 1 attachment (ID 1085, title 'PWS - CFM EPA WJCB EWC 09 23 2022'). Response structure correct with success, attachments array, count fields.

Tested with attachment_id=1085. Downloads 1.4MB PDF successfully. Returns correct response structure (success, clauses, total_detected, total_filtered). Note: PWS document contains 0 extractable FAR/DFARS clauses.
Both endpoints return 401 Unauthorized without session_token cookie.

features_verified_this_iteration.feature: Frontend /agiloft page - 'Upload to Contract' tab with 2 source tabs
features_verified_this_iteration.verification: Page shows 4 main tabs. 'Upload to Contract' tab contains 2 source sub-tabs: 'Upload Local File' (data-testid=source-tab-upload) and 'Contract Attachments' (data-testid=source-tab-attachments).
When no contract is selected, shows placeholder: 'Select a contract from the left panel to view its attachments'
Code review confirms Step 3 is implemented at lines 1359-1530 in AgiloftIntegration.jsx. Shows after clause verification with preview-link-btn, back-to-selection-btn, confirm-link-btn data-testids.

critical_code_review_comments: ContractAttachmentsRequest model at line 5476 correctly defines kb_url, username, password, kb_name, contract_id fields
get_contract_attachments endpoint at line 5484 uses SOAP EWSelectAndRead_WSAttachment to query attachments by contract_id
DownloadExtractRequest model at line 5542 correctly defines attachment_id field
download_attachment_and_extract endpoint at line 5550 uses SOAP EWRetrieveAttached to download PDF and runs _extract_clauses_with_checkboxes()
Frontend sourceTab state at line 82 controls switching between 'upload' and 'attachments' tabs
fetchContractAttachments at line 550 calls /api/agiloft/contract-attachments with correct payload
handleAttachmentExtract at line 580 calls /api/agiloft/download-attachment-and-extract and updates extractedClauses state
